read.en: MP Materials rose 1.2% on Oct 21 to $39.50 on light volume, trading between $39.16 and $39.85. It remains below all its falling averages: the 5-day ($39.86), 10-day ($41.73), 30-day ($46.22), 100-day ($51.48) and 200-day ($56.04). MACD has been below its signal since Aug 31 and is below zero, with the histogram narrowing; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 12 ($44.93), and RSI is 32.
read.zh: MP Materials 10月21日上涨 1.2%，收于 $39.50，成交清淡，盘中区间 $39.16–39.85。股价仍位于所有下行均线下方：5 日（$39.86）、10 日（$41.73）、30 日（$46.22）、100 日（$51.48）和 200 日均线（$56.04）。MACD 自 8月31日起位于信号线及零轴下方，柱状图收窄；抛物线 SAR 自 10月12日起看空（$44.93），RSI 为 32。

read.en: An inside day: the low stayed above the $37.81 52-week low and the high stalled under $40. Resistance is $39.9–40.2 (5-day average, Oct 20 high), then $41.7 (10-day) and $44.5–44.9 (Oct 1 low, SAR). Support is $37.9–38.6 (Oct 20 and 15 lows), then $37.8 (52-week low) and $35. A close above $40.2 would target $41.7; a close below $37.8 would set a new 52-week low.
read.zh: 内包日：低点守在 $37.81 的 52 周低点上方，高点受阻于 $40 下方。阻力为 $39.9–40.2（5 日均线、10月20日高点），其次 $41.7（10 日均线）和 $44.5–44.9（10月1日低点、SAR）。支撑为 $37.9–38.6（10月15日和20日低点），其次 $37.8（52 周低点）和 $35。若收盘站上 $40.2，下一目标看 $41.7；若收盘跌破 $37.8，将创 52 周新低。
